column1: # The existing SDK-wide address-region rules apply; no game-specific patches.
# NPDM: 16 MB of system resource, enabling virtual address memory. No heap set.
# With the 3.21 GB survey pool, StandardAllocator reserves 3.14 GB; the initial
# 15-second check reaches alias +4.20 GB, but gameplay reaches at least +4.76 GB.
# Report a 2 GB pool so StandardAllocator leaves room for Unity's other regions.
# Its reservation is then 1.94 GB; a saved-map load reaches alias +3.26 GB of 4.38.
# Device testing remains open. See README.md for the Mac layout check.
# The game sets near = 0; prebuild pipeline bases with the same depth convention.
# heap check: 2026-11-15, no heap set; depth_mode zero; address regions fit.
